name: Haus Obwaller
beschreibung: Haus Obwaller is located in the district of Söll, Tirol, in the quiet surroundings of the Wilder Kaiser Region. The holiday apartments are equipped with a fully equipped kitchen and comfortable living areas. As it is a holiday apartment, self-catering is possible; several restaurants are nearby. The surrounding area offers hiking and cycling trails in summer as well as the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental ski area in winter. The house impresses with its quiet location and traditional Tiroler architectural style, creating a cozy atmosphere. The village center of Söll is within walking distance.
